title: Jericho vs. Orange Cassidy
summary: Jericho’s disdain for Cassidy turns into a rivalry that mixes personal embarrassment with increasingly unusual matches.

chapters.title: Cassidy beats Jericho
chapters.result: Cassidy wins the rematch against Jericho.
chapters.context: The victory earns Cassidy another measure of credibility against the veteran.

chapters.title: Mimosa Mayhem
chapters.result: Cassidy sends Jericho into the mimosa vat to win.
chapters.context: The unusual stipulation delivers the rivalry’s comic payoff.
